title: ‘Doctor Strange’ Director Says Elon Musk ‘Doesn’t Know S— About Cinema’ After Musk Vows to Make AI ‘Odyssey’: ‘His Opinions on Art Are Worthless’
content:
ByEthan Shanfeld

Elon Musk’s crusade against Christopher Nolan’s “The Odyssey” has raised eyebrows in Hollywood after the newly minted trillionaire vowed that before the end of the year, his AI tool Grok “will make a full-length movie of The Odyssey that is historically accurate and true to the art of Homer.” Musk alsoshared a three-minute clipof an AI-generated scene adapted from the poem, which was manufactured by a user on Grok.

One figure from the film community, “Doctor Strange” and “The Black Phone” directorScott Derrickson, pulled no punches whenaddressing Musk directlyon social media. “Clearly @elonmusk doesn’t know shit about cinema & he stopped reading in his 20s,” Derrickson wrote on Musk’s social media platform, X. “His opinions on art are worthless.”

The Tesla mogul has railed against Nolan’s “Odyssey” long before it was released due to his perception of certain “woke” casting decisions. In March, Musk wrote that “Chris Nolan is an anti-White racist” for casting Lupita Nyong’o in the role of Helen of Troy, asserting that the director made the decision because “he wants the awards.” Musk said “Chris Nolan has lost his integrity” and called the casting an “insult” to Homer. Musk also took aim at Elliott Page, who plays Sinon in “The Odyssey,” reposting comments that mocked the transgender actor’s masculinity.

“The Odyssey” is not the first film Musk has criticized on X; he similarly mocked “Barbie” for its feminist themes and Disney’s “Snow White” reboot led by Rachel Zegler. The anti-woke backlash to “The Odyssey” didn’t seem to matter. The Matt Damon-starring epic opened to $264 million worldwide and continues to sell out screenings months in advance.
title_zh: 《奇異博士》(Doctor Strange) 導演斯科特·德瑞克森(Scott Derrickson)表示，埃隆·馬斯克(Elon Musk)「對電影一無所知」，這是在馬斯克承諾將製作人工智慧(AI)的《奧德賽》(Odyssey)之後發表的評論。他指出：「他的藝術觀點毫無價值。」
content_zh:
作者：伊桑·香菲爾德(Ethan Shanfeld)

伊隆·馬斯克(Elon Musk)對克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)的《奧德賽》(The Odyssey)的攻擊在好萊塢引起了關注，這位新晉的兆萬富翁誓言在年底之前，他的人工智慧工具Grok“將製作一部歷史準確且忠於荷馬藝術的《奧德賽》長片。”馬斯克還分享了一段三分鐘的片段，該片段是由Grok上的用戶根據詩歌改編的人工智慧生成場景。

電影界的一位人物，《奇異博士》(Doctor Strange)和《黑電話》(The Black Phone)導演斯科特·德瑞克森(Scott Derrickson)在社交媒體上直言不諱地回應馬斯克。“顯然@elonmusk對電影一無所知，他在20多歲時就停止閱讀了，”德瑞克森在馬斯克的社交媒體平台X上寫道。“他對藝術的看法毫無價值。”

這位特斯拉大亨早在《奧德賽》上映之前就因為對某些“覺醒”演員選擇的看法而對諾蘭的《奧德賽》發表過批評。今年三月，馬斯克因為諾蘭選擇露皮塔·尼永奧(Lupita Nyong’o)飾演特洛伊的海倫而稱其為“反白人種族主義者”，並聲稱導演這樣做是因為“他想要獎項。”馬斯克表示“克里斯·諾蘭失去了他的誠信”，並稱這一選角是對荷馬的“侮辱”。馬斯克還對在《奧德賽》中飾演西農(Sinon)的艾略特·佩吉(Elliott Page)發起攻擊，轉發了嘲諷這位跨性別演員男性氣概的評論。

《奧德賽》並不是馬斯克在X上批評的第一部電影；他同樣嘲諷過《芭比》(Barbie)的女性主義主題以及由瑞秋·齊格勒(Rachel Zegler)主導的迪士尼《白雪公主》(Snow White)重啟版。對《奧德賽》的反覺醒反彈似乎並不重要。這部由馬特·達蒙(Matt Damon)主演的史詩電影全球首映便獲得了2.64億美元的票房，並且在幾個月前就已經售罄了放映場次。
